title: Record to Report Row
prompt:
Implement `void report_row(const char* line)` that parses `<item> <count> <price>` (e.g. `"bolt 12 0.05"`) and prints one row:

```
| bolt        |  12 | 0.05 |
```

Item left-aligned width 12; count right-aligned width 3; price with exactly 2 decimals, right-aligned width 5. Spaces around `|` exactly as shown.

tests.name: exact report row
tests.code:
const char* out = cj_capture(program);
CHECK_STR_EQ(out, "| bolt         |  12 |  0.05 |\n");
tests.hint: char item[32]; int count; double price; sscanf(line, "%31s %d %lf", item, &count, &price); then printf("| %-12s | %3d | %5.2f |\n", ...).
